exposure: Early term delivery (37-38 weeks of gestation)
Late preterm delivery (34-36 weeks of gestation)
cohort: Singleton live births at 34-41 weeks of gestation to women in London and Middlesex, Ontario, Canada (n = 25,699) from 2002-2011.
finding: All maternal, fetal, and placental phenotypes were associated with increased odds of medically indicated late preterm and early term delivery.
